d1.name: Rashi
d1.summary: The main chart describes the overall pattern: identity, life direction, houses, and the natal promise that every other varga must refine rather than replace.
d1.readWith: Begin here. No divisional conclusion should contradict a weak or absent promise in D1.
d1.clientQuestion: What is the central pattern through which the rest of this reading unfolds?
d1.sensitivityNote: Planetary signs are comparatively stable; the ascendant and houses still depend on the recorded birth time.
d1.mappingMethod: Natal sidereal sign placement without subdivision.

d2.name: Hora
d2.summary: D2 refines the way resources are gathered, protected, shared, and converted into material stability.
d2.readWith: Read with the D1 second and eleventh houses, their lords, and Jupiter and Venus strength.
d2.clientQuestion: What style of resource-building is easiest to sustain over time?
d2.sensitivityNote: Use an exact birth time before promoting the D2 ascendant or houses into a firm conclusion.
d2.mappingMethod: Parashari Hora: odd signs run from Leo to Cancer; even signs run from Cancer to Leo.

d4.name: Chaturthamsa
d4.summary: D4 refines home, property, settlement, emotional rootedness, and the conditions that make a place feel secure.
d4.readWith: Read with the D1 fourth house, Moon, Mars, and relevant property or relocation periods.
d4.clientQuestion: What conditions help home and long-term security become genuinely restorative?
d4.sensitivityNote: An exact time is important because the divisional ascendant can change within a short interval.
d4.mappingMethod: Chaturthamsa quarters map to the 1st, 4th, 7th, and 10th signs from the natal sign.

d7.name: Saptamsa
d7.summary: D7 refines themes of children, caregiving, mentorship, creative continuation, and what is carried into the next generation.
d7.readWith: Read with the D1 fifth house, Jupiter, its lord, and supportive timing periods.
d7.clientQuestion: How does the chart describe care, continuation, and the legacy you cultivate?
d7.sensitivityNote: Treat D7 house-based statements as provisional unless the recorded time is exact.
d7.mappingMethod: Parashari Saptamsa: odd signs begin from the natal sign; even signs begin from its seventh.

d9.name: Navamsa
d9.summary: D9 refines relationship maturity, commitments, values, dharma, and how natal potential develops with experience.
d9.readWith: Read with the D1 seventh house, Venus, Jupiter, relationship rules, and the active dasha lords.
d9.clientQuestion: What qualities help commitment become more mature and sustainable?
d9.sensitivityNote: D9 is highly useful, but its ascendant should be trusted only when the birth time is exact.
d9.mappingMethod: Parashari Navamsa: movable signs begin from themselves, fixed signs from the ninth, and dual signs from the fifth.

d10.name: Dashamsa
d10.summary: D10 refines vocation, responsibility, leadership, professional visibility, and the way work reaches the wider world.
d10.readWith: Read with the D1 tenth house, its lord, Sun, Saturn, Mercury, and current career timing.
d10.clientQuestion: Where can competence become visible, useful, and increasingly authoritative?
d10.sensitivityNote: Small time errors can change the D10 ascendant; confirm it before making specific career claims.
d10.mappingMethod: Parashari Dashamsa: odd signs begin from the natal sign; even signs begin from its ninth.

d12.name: Dwadashamsa
d12.summary: D12 refines parental influence, ancestry, inherited habits, and the family patterns a person carries forward or consciously changes.
d12.readWith: Read with the D1 fourth and ninth houses, Sun, Moon, and family-domain evidence.
d12.clientQuestion: Which inherited patterns provide support, and which are ready to be handled differently?
d12.sensitivityNote: Use exact-time data for the D12 ascendant and house emphasis.
d12.mappingMethod: Dwadashamsa portions proceed zodiacally from the natal sign.

d24.name: Chaturvimshamsa
d24.summary: D24 refines education, learning style, disciplined study, teachers, and how knowledge becomes usable mastery.
d24.readWith: Read with the D1 fourth, fifth, and ninth houses, plus Mercury and Jupiter strength.
d24.clientQuestion: Which conditions make learning deeper, more consistent, and easier to apply?
d24.sensitivityNote: At this resolution, exact birth time and boundary awareness are essential.
d24.mappingMethod: Chaturvimshamsa portions begin from Leo in odd signs and Cancer in even signs.

d30.name: Trimshamsa
d30.summary: D30 refines how strain, conflict, vulnerability, and recovery are experienced. It is best used for practical risk awareness, not fear-based prediction.
d30.readWith: Read with the D1 sixth, eighth, and twelfth houses, Saturn and Mars, and measured support factors.
d30.clientQuestion: What helps you respond to pressure without letting it define the whole story?
d30.sensitivityNote: High sensitivity makes exact-time input necessary for house-level interpretation.
d30.mappingMethod: Parashari Trimshamsa uses five unequal planetary portions whose boundaries differ in odd and even signs.

d60.name: Shashtiamsa
d60.summary: D60 is a very fine-grained traditional layer used to qualify deeper patterning. It should never be treated as a standalone verdict or used to override more stable evidence.
d60.readWith: Use only after D1, the relevant domain varga, strength measures, and timing all point in the same direction.
d60.clientQuestion: Does this fine layer repeat an already well-supported theme, or merely introduce noise?
d60.sensitivityNote: D60 needs a rectified or exceptionally precise birth time; otherwise treat it as exploratory only.
d60.mappingMethod: Shashtiamsa divides each natal sign into sixty half-degree portions whose signs cycle zodiacally from Aries.

missing.title: Chart details are incomplete.
missing.lead: Return to intake and provide complete birth details before opening the divisional chart atlas.

unavailable.title: The divisional charts could not be prepared.
unavailable.fallback: No divisional chart data was returned.

hero.heading: {name}'s divisional chart layers
hero.lead: The D1 is the foundation. Each higher varga magnifies one life area, helping the reading confirm, qualify, or narrow a theme already present in the main chart.

reliability.label: Birth time reliability
reliability.goodBody: The atlas can display every supported varga. D30 and D60 still deserve boundary checks because their divisions are exceptionally fine.
reliability.cautionTitle: Use higher divisions as exploratory layers
reliability.cautionBody: The recorded time is approximate or a fallback. Planetary sign subdivisions are shown, but ascendant- and house-based conclusions in higher vargas should not be promoted until the birth time is rectified.

important.heading: Start with the charts that answer a clear question
important.lead: These ten receive fuller guidance because they add the most useful context to a client-focused reading. They are not ten competing natal charts.

complete.heading: All calculated vargas
complete.lead: Select any chart to inspect the client's placements. The ten key charts include additional interpretation guidance below.

detail.traditionNote: Outside Parashara’s sixteen vargas — read as a supplementary layer, not a classical authority.
detail.secondaryNote: This is a supporting chart in the complete atlas. It can add context, but the report should promote it only when the D1 and a relevant key varga already support the same conclusion.

positions.heading: {label} position map
positions.note: “Repeats” means the point remains in the same sign as D1. It is a consistency signal, not automatically positive or negative.

atlas.footer: Divisional charts increase specificity only when they confirm the natal promise, use reliable birth data, and agree with independent strength and timing factors.

panel.heading: Divisional Charts
panel.intro: D1 is the natal foundation; the remaining charts magnify specific life themes by subdividing each sign. Select a chart below to see where each planet lands in that division.
panel.hint: Planets in the same sign as their rashi position are highlighted. This repetition strengthens that planet's expression in the corresponding life area. D5, D6, D8, and D11 use extended traditional mappings; they sit outside the classical sixteen Parashari vargas.

themes.d1: Overall life, identity, and the natal foundation
themes.d6: Health patterns, routines, and everyday obstacles
themes.d11: Gains, networks, and the fulfillment of ambitions
themes.d60: Past life karma and general matters

errors.missingBody: Return to intake and provide the complete birth details before opening the {label} {name} analysis.
errors.unavailableTitle: The {name} detail could not be prepared.
errors.unavailableBody: {label} was not returned by the chart calculation.

reliability.note: Boundary distance below describes proximity to the source-rashi subdivision; it is not a probability or a favorable/unfavorable score.

glance.heading: The chart facts before interpretation
glance.note: A D1 sign recurrence is a consistency marker only. It is not automatically positive, strong, or predictive.

map.heading: {label} South-Indian-style chart
map.invalidAscendant: A valid divisional ascendant was not returned, so house placement is withheld.
map.note: This map derives whole-sign houses from the divisional ascendant. It does not infer exact aspects or replace the natal house system.

placements.heading: Points connected to this chart's focus
placements.strengthNote: Independent natal delivery strength; this is not a {label} dignity score.

table.heading: Every calculated point
table.caption: {label} positions compared with D1, including whole-sign house, sign lord, dignity, recurrence, and source subdivision boundary distance.
table.note: Classical dignity is shown only for the seven classical planets. No dignity is assigned here to the Ascendant, Rahu, or Ketu. Boundary distance is measured from each point's natal degree to the nearest subdivision edge.

timing.heading: Dasha lords inside {label}
timing.dashaUnavailable: Current dasha data was not returned.
timing.note: An active period increases timing relevance; it does not make a placement automatically favorable. Read it with D1, measured strength, and lived evidence.

method.heading: How this page was calculated
method.vargaHouseDisplayValue: Whole-sign houses derived from the {label} Ascendant
method.cautionBody: This page reports calculated signs, whole-sign houses, rulers, classical dignity, and timing-lord location. It does not infer exact divisional aspects, treat sign recurrence as automatically positive, or let {label} override D1.

footer.note: Divisional charts refine a natal promise; they do not replace it. Stronger conclusions require reliable birth data and agreement with independent evidence.
